source_text: If you’re just going to cause trouble, maybe you should stay home.

structure.raw_value: McAnDe.If you’re just going to cause trouble, maybe you should stay home.
structure.script_literal: "McAnDe.If you’re just going to cause trouble, maybe you should stay home."

translation: Jeśli masz tylko sprawiać kłopoty, może lepiej zostań w domu.

source_text: What?! I want to go to Heather’s house too!

structure.raw_value: HnShAgNo1.What?! I want to go to Heather’s house too!
structure.script_literal: "HnShAgNo1.What?! I want to go to Heather’s house too!"

translation: Co?! Ja też chcę iść do Heather!

source_text: That’s all I came here to ask. No need to pick on me.

structure.raw_value: McAnEx.That’s all I came here to ask. No need to pick on me.
structure.script_literal: "McAnEx.That’s all I came here to ask. No need to pick on me."

translation: Tylko o to chciałem zapytać. Nie musisz się na mnie wyżywać.

source_text: Poor 1Hero. Got your feelin’s hurt?

structure.raw_value: HnFlOp.Poor 1Hero. Got your feelin’s hurt?
structure.script_literal: "HnFlOp.Poor 1Hero. Got your feelin’s hurt?"

translation: Biedny 1Hero. Uraziłam twoje uczucia?

source_text: You know, I bought that house I was telling you about.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.You know, I bought that house I was telling you about.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.You know, I bought that house I was telling you about."

translation: Wiesz, kupiłam ten dom, o którym ci opowiadałam.

source_text: Time to party!

structure.raw_value: HnHaAg.Time to party!
structure.script_literal: "HnHaAg.Time to party!"

translation: Czas na imprezę!

source_text: It’s still not much to look at. I need to fix it up.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.It’s still not much to look at. I need to fix it up.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.It’s still not much to look at. I need to fix it up."

translation: Na razie nie wygląda najlepiej. Muszę go wyremontować.

source_text: I’ve got a plan for you, 1Hero.

structure.raw_value: HnFlEx.I’ve got a plan for you, 1Hero.
structure.script_literal: "HnFlEx.I’ve got a plan for you, 1Hero."

translation: Mam dla ciebie plan, 1Hero.

source_text: I’m going to play matchmaker with you.

structure.raw_value: HnFlOp.I’m going to play matchmaker with you.
structure.script_literal: "HnFlOp.I’m going to play matchmaker with you."

translation: Zostanę twoją swatką.

source_text: See ya tonight at dinner.

structure.raw_value: HnFlOp.See ya tonight at dinner.
structure.script_literal: "HnFlOp.See ya tonight at dinner."

translation: Do zobaczenia wieczorem przy kolacji.

source_text: Okay, Dad!

structure.raw_value: HnAnDeNo1.Okay, Dad!
structure.script_literal: "HnAnDeNo1.Okay, Dad!"

translation: Dobrze, tato!

source_text: And maybe put some clothes on.

structure.raw_value: McFlEx.And maybe put some clothes on.
structure.script_literal: "McFlEx.And maybe put some clothes on."

translation: I może coś na siebie załóż.

source_text: Thanks for being there for me, 1Hero.

structure.raw_value: ChFrOp.Thanks for being there for me, 1Hero.
structure.script_literal: "ChFrOp.Thanks for being there for me, 1Hero."

translation: Dzięki, że przy mnie jesteś, 1Hero.

source_text: You’re a good teacher.

structure.raw_value: ChHaOp.You’re a good teacher.
structure.script_literal: "ChHaOp.You’re a good teacher."

translation: Jesteś dobrym nauczycielem.

source_text: I hope Hannah doesn’t tickle you anymore.

structure.raw_value: McFlEx.I hope Hannah doesn’t tickle you anymore.
structure.script_literal: "McFlEx.I hope Hannah doesn’t tickle you anymore."

translation: Mam nadzieję, że Hannah już cię nie łaskocze.

source_text: Haha. Maybe I should keep my pants on around her.

structure.raw_value: ChFlOpNo4.Haha. Maybe I should keep my pants on around her.
structure.script_literal: "ChFlOpNo4.Haha. Maybe I should keep my pants on around her."

translation: Haha. Może powinienem przy niej nie zdejmować spodni.

source_text: I don’t know how I feel about seeing Ma get a dickin’.

structure.raw_value: HnWoDe.I don’t know how I feel about seeing Ma get a dickin’.
structure.script_literal: "HnWoDe.I don’t know how I feel about seeing Ma get a dickin’."

translation: Nie wiem, co myśleć o tym, że ktoś rżnie mamę.

source_text: I hope it’s okay.

structure.raw_value: McWoOp.I hope it’s okay.
structure.script_literal: "McWoOp.I hope it’s okay."

translation: Mam nadzieję, że wszystko w porządku.

source_text: If you fall in love with Ma, I’ll kick your ass.

structure.raw_value: HnAnEx.If you fall in love with Ma, I’ll kick your ass.
structure.script_literal: "HnAnEx.If you fall in love with Ma, I’ll kick your ass."

translation: Jeśli zakochasz się w mamie, skopię ci tyłek.

source_text: I’m so hungry!

structure.raw_value: HnSaOp^.I’m so hungry!
structure.script_literal: "HnSaOp^.I’m so hungry!"

translation: Ale jestem głodna!

source_text: Dinner’s almost ready. Did you put the goat back in its pen?

structure.raw_value: CaBaEx.Dinner’s almost ready. Did you put the goat back in its pen?
structure.script_literal: "CaBaEx.Dinner’s almost ready. Did you put the goat back in its pen?"

translation: Kolacja prawie gotowa. Wprowadziłaś kozła z powrotem do zagrody?

source_text: I totally forgot.

structure.raw_value: HnSaDe^.I totally forgot.
structure.script_literal: "HnSaDe^.I totally forgot."

translation: Całkiem o tym zapomniałam.

source_text: I’ll go check on him.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.I’ll go check on him.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.I’ll go check on him."

translation: Pójdę do niego zajrzeć.

source_text: Ma! What are you doing back already?

structure.raw_value: HnShClNo1.Ma! What are you doing back already?
structure.script_literal: "HnShClNo1.Ma! What are you doing back already?"

translation: Mamo! Czemu tak szybko wróciłaś?

source_text: Hannah! Where are your pants?

structure.raw_value: CaShOp>.Hannah! Where are your pants?
structure.script_literal: "CaShOp>.Hannah! Where are your pants?"

translation: Hannah! Gdzie masz spodnie?

source_text: Chloe? What are you three up to?

structure.raw_value: CaFlDe>.Chloe? What are you three up to?
structure.script_literal: "CaFlDe>.Chloe? What are you three up to?"

translation: Chloe? Co wy trzy wyprawiacie?

source_text: Uhh… Carol…

structure.raw_value: McWoCl.Uhh… Carol…
structure.script_literal: "McWoCl.Uhh… Carol…"

translation: Eee… Carol…

source_text: We were just looking for Chloe’s shirt.

structure.raw_value: HnWoEx.We were just looking for Chloe’s shirt.
structure.script_literal: "HnWoEx.We were just looking for Chloe’s shirt."

translation: Szukałyśmy tylko koszuli Chloe.

source_text: How does that explain the lack of pants?

structure.raw_value: CaFlDe>.How does that explain the lack of pants?
structure.script_literal: "CaFlDe>.How does that explain the lack of pants?"

translation: I co ma do tego brak spodni?

source_text: We’ve got major clothes problems.

structure.raw_value: HnWoEx.We’ve got major clothes problems.
structure.script_literal: "HnWoEx.We’ve got major clothes problems."

translation: Mamy poważny problem z ubraniami.

source_text: Well, good luck. I’m sure 1Hero is being very helpful.

structure.raw_value: CaFlEx>.Well, good luck. I’m sure 1Hero is being very helpful.
structure.script_literal: "CaFlEx>.Well, good luck. I’m sure 1Hero is being very helpful."

translation: No to powodzenia. Jestem pewna, że 1Hero bardzo wam pomaga.

source_text: What the hell is she doing back? I thought you said she’d be gone for an hour.

structure.raw_value: ChWoCl.What the hell is she doing back? I thought you said she’d be gone for an hour.
structure.script_literal: "ChWoCl.What the hell is she doing back? I thought you said she’d be gone for an hour."

translation: Co ona tu robi? Mówiłaś, że nie będzie jej przez godzinę.

source_text: She was! She must have forgotten something.

structure.raw_value: HnWoEx.She was! She must have forgotten something.
structure.script_literal: "HnWoEx.She was! She must have forgotten something."

translation: Nie było jej! Musiała o czymś zapomnieć.

source_text: Don’t worry. Carol is cool about this kind of stuff.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.Don’t worry. Carol is cool about this kind of stuff.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.Don’t worry. Carol is cool about this kind of stuff."

translation: Spokojnie. Carol nie robi problemów z takich rzeczy.

source_text: She’s going to tell my mom. She tells her everything.

structure.raw_value: ChWoCl.She’s going to tell my mom. She tells her everything.
structure.script_literal: "ChWoCl.She’s going to tell my mom. She tells her everything."

translation: Powiem mamie. Ona opowiada jej wszystko.

source_text: Who cares? It’s not like no one’s ever seen us naked.

structure.raw_value: HnAnEx.Who cares? It’s not like no one’s ever seen us naked.
structure.script_literal: "HnAnEx.Who cares? It’s not like no one’s ever seen us naked."

translation: Kogo to obchodzi? To nie tak, że nikt nigdy nie widział nas nago.

source_text: Argh! Why does everything have to suck!

structure.raw_value: ChAnDe.Argh! Why does everything have to suck!
structure.script_literal: "ChAnDe.Argh! Why does everything have to suck!"

translation: Argh! Czemu wszystko musi być beznadziejne?!

source_text: Stop your belly-achin’!

structure.raw_value: HnAnEx.Stop your belly-achin’!
structure.script_literal: "HnAnEx.Stop your belly-achin’!"

translation: Przestań marudzić!

source_text: Put your clothes back on. I’ll smooth things over with Carol.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.Put your clothes back on. I’ll smooth things over with Carol.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.Put your clothes back on. I’ll smooth things over with Carol."

translation: Ubierzcie się. Załatwię to z Carol.

source_text: What’s wrong, Carol?

structure.raw_value: McWoOp.What’s wrong, Carol?
structure.script_literal: "McWoOp.What’s wrong, Carol?"

translation: Co się stało, Carol?

source_text: I just got this letter from the court.

structure.raw_value: CaAnEx.I just got this letter from the court.
structure.script_literal: "CaAnEx.I just got this letter from the court."

translation: Właśnie dostałam pismo z sądu.

source_text: It says the state is taking over my farm.

structure.raw_value: CaAnDe.It says the state is taking over my farm.
structure.script_literal: "CaAnDe.It says the state is taking over my farm."

translation: Piszą, że państwo przejmuje moją farmę.

source_text: Because of the Casula ruins in the cave. Somehow they know about them.

structure.raw_value: CaAnEx.Because of the Casula ruins in the cave. Somehow they know about them.
structure.script_literal: "CaAnEx.Because of the Casula ruins in the cave. Somehow they know about them."

translation: Chodzi o ruiny Casula w jaskini. W jakiś sposób się o nich dowiedzieli.

source_text: The letter says the government has a responsibility to preserve indigenous culture.

structure.raw_value: CaAnDe.The letter says the government has a responsibility to preserve indigenous culture.
structure.script_literal: "CaAnDe.The letter says the government has a responsibility to preserve indigenous culture."

translation: W piśmie napisano, że rząd ma obowiązek chronić kulturę rdzennych mieszkańców.

source_text: For some reason, it also mentions clearing and developing the rest of the farm for ‘’government housing’’.

structure.raw_value: CaBaDe.For some reason, it also mentions clearing and developing the rest of the farm for ‘’government housing’’.
structure.script_literal: "CaBaDe.For some reason, it also mentions clearing and developing the rest of the farm for ‘’government housing’’."

translation: Z jakiegoś powodu wspominają też o wyburzeniu i zabudowaniu reszty farmy pod „mieszkania rządowe”.

source_text: That sounds weird.

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.That sounds weird.
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.That sounds weird."

translation: To brzmi podejrzanie.

source_text: I don’t want to lose my home, 1Hero.

structure.raw_value: CaWoDe.I don’t want to lose my home, 1Hero.
structure.script_literal: "CaWoDe.I don’t want to lose my home, 1Hero."

translation: Nie chcę stracić domu, 1Hero.

source_text: There must be something you can do.

structure.raw_value: McWoEx.There must be something you can do.
structure.script_literal: "McWoEx.There must be something you can do."

translation: Musi być coś, co możesz zrobić.

source_text: Raise hell is what I’m going to do.

structure.raw_value: CaMaDe.Raise hell is what I’m going to do.
structure.script_literal: "CaMaDe.Raise hell is what I’m going to do."

translation: Zrobię taką awanturę, jakiej jeszcze nie widzieli.

source_text: I’m goin’ to give the judge who signed this a piece of my mind!

structure.raw_value: CaMaAg.I’m goin’ to give the judge who signed this a piece of my mind!
structure.script_literal: "CaMaAg.I’m goin’ to give the judge who signed this a piece of my mind!"

translation: Powiem temu sędziemu, który to podpisał, co o nim myślę!

source_text: Well, that’s…

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.Well, that’s…
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.Well, that’s…"

translation: No cóż…

source_text: Oooh, boy.

structure.raw_value: McWoOp.Oooh, boy.
structure.script_literal: "McWoOp.Oooh, boy."

translation: Oho, będzie się działo.
